items.question: How does the consumer complaints platform work for submitting complaints?
items.answer: The platform allows you to submit your complaint details and supporting documents easily. Our team reviews them, documents them with a reference number, and contacts the company concerned to follow up on reaching a positive solution.

items.question: Is the complaint submission service free for consumers in the UAE?
items.answer: Yes, documenting, submitting, and following up on complaints is completely free for all consumers and clients within the United Arab Emirates.

items.question: What role does the platform play in resolving the issue with the company?
items.answer: We legally document the complaint, issue a reference number, and address the business management to reach a fair settlement that protects consumer rights in accordance with established regulations.

about.storyP1: The platform began as a private initiative led by a team believing consumers deserve a clear channel to document experiences with private companies. Noticing many complaints get lost in email chains and call center queues, we built a dedicated platform to keep every complaint documented from submission to response.
about.storyP2: We are a fully independent private entity and do not represent any government agency. We operate transparently with absolute commitment to user privacy and data protection.

faq.title: Answers to Your Most Common Questions
faq.description: We have collected the most frequent questions we receive about our platform and services.

items.q: Is this platform affiliated with a government entity in the UAE?
items.a: No. The platform is completely private and independent, and does not represent any government or official entity in the UAE.

items.q: What types of complaints does the platform accept?
items.a: We handle complaints related to private companies across sectors like telecom, e-commerce, real estate, aviation, private financial services, and more.

items.q: Is the complaint submission service free?
items.a: Yes, submitting a complaint through the platform is 100% free for consumers.

items.q: How long does it take to process a complaint?
items.a: We usually review complaints within 24 business hours, while final response times depend on the company involved.

items.q: Do you guarantee a solution or resolution?
items.a: We do not offer any guarantees of resolution or financial compensation. Our role is professional documentation and follow-up.

items.q: How does the platform protect my data?
items.a: We adhere to best data protection practices and never share your information except as necessary for processing the complaint. Read our Privacy Policy for more.

items.q: Can I modify or delete my submitted complaint?
items.a: Yes, you can contact us via email to request modification or removal of your data in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

items.q: Do you handle complaints against government entities?
items.a: No, the platform is strictly for complaints against private sector companies. For government-related complaints, please reach out to official channels.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This document explains what data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.sec1Item1: Identity details: Name, email address, phone number, emirate.
privacy.sec1Item2: Complaint content: Company name and details provided in the form.
privacy.sec1Item3: Technical data: IP address, browser type, time of visit (for security purposes).
privacy.sec2Desc: We use your data to document your complaint, forward it to the relevant company, communicate with you regarding its status, and improve platform services.
privacy.sec3Desc: Data is stored on secure servers and retained for as long as necessary to process the complaint and for a reasonable additional period for legal or operational purposes, up to a maximum of 24 months.
privacy.sec4Desc: We use essential cookies required to run the site, and we may use analytical cookies to understand site usage and improve your experience.
privacy.sec5Desc: We do not sell your data. We share complaint details only with the involved company and technical service providers subject to confidentiality obligations.
privacy.sec6Desc: We implement technical and organizational measures to safeguard your data, including encryption in transit and periodic access reviews.
privacy.sec7Item2: Right to correct or update it.
privacy.sec7Item3: Right to request deletion subject to applicable policies.
privacy.sec7Item4: Right to withdraw consent for processing.
privacy.sec7ContactPrefix: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at
privacy.sec8Desc: We may update this policy from time to time. Any updates will be posted on this page along with the latest revision date.
